blocks.text: A notice to appear shall be used in all cases involving the violation of a municipal ordinance, except when a warrant is issued. (Ord. 20206 § 9, 9-10-19; Ord. 17666 § 22, 3-27-01. Code 1995 § 50-57. Formerly 2.110.200.)
State Law References: Similar State statute, K.S.A. 12-4206 .
